name: Bellianic Crown
body:
Aura faint abjuration and divination; CL 5th; Slot head; Price 14,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This simple headband is adorned with a single reddish crystal that sits above the brow.

The crown grants the wearer a continuous sanctuary (DC 12); if the wearer attacks, this effect is suppressed for 24 hours. As long as the sanctuary persists, the wearer also gains a +5 bonus on Diplomacy and wild empathy checks. In addition, once per day the crown can radiate a sphere of peaceful communication and negotiation. This functions as calm emotions (DC 13), and in addition all affected creatures gain the benefit of sanctuary and can understand each other’s speech as if using tongues. The effect lasts for 10 minutes, typically enough time for an Accord agent to make peaceful first contact with a new species.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, calm emotions, sanctuary, tongues; Cost 7,000 gp
